_doc: P3.MESSAGING.1 — proposed schema for direct messaging. SCAFFOLD ONLY. No backend code, no live tables. Schema lives here as the canonical reference for the future BE implementation. Doctrine: no mixed-language. Free join, free 1 DM/day, paid DM Plus (€1/mo) = unlimited + read receipts.

messages._doc: One row per individual message in a DM thread. Body is NOT indexed for search (privacy doctrine).

read_at.comment: set only if recipient has DM Plus OR if sender has DM Plus (read receipt visibility tied to either side's plan)

paid_at.comment: if message was sent under a paid plan window, stamp the plan activation time; null for free-tier messages

flag_count.comment: spam flag counter; >=3 routes to review queue

dm_threads._doc: Two-party thread; participants[] is a 2-element array. Group DMs are out of scope for P3.

is_closed.comment: closed = either party blocked or reported

dm_quota._doc: Per-user-per-day rolling DM send count. Free tier capped at 1 outbound/day. Paid (dm_plus_monthly) bypasses the cap.

rules.free_dm_eligibility: free outbound limited to recipients who are flagged as verified comic or verified booker (not random users)
rules.read_receipts: only when at least one side has dm_plus_monthly active
spam_prevention: per-thread cooldown 60s between messages from same sender
blocked recipient sets is_closed=true and prevents new threads from same sender for 30d
privacy: body column NOT indexed for full-text search
no message body content exposed via any /api/search endpoint
operator review only on flagged threads

transport_decision._doc: Defer transport choice to BE implementation phase.
transport_decision.recommendation_pending_be_phase: start with polling (15s) for v1; upgrade to SSE if concurrent DM users > 200
